description: Trace one real software change from planning authority through architecture, implementation, verification, deployed product UI, and owner review state without moving DoDAF semantics or workflow authority into Representation Router.

viewSpecs.concern: How does this change trace from planned outcome to architecture decision, implementation, evidence, deployed UI, and current review state?

interactions.effect: highlight upstream and downstream trace links
interactions.purpose: keep the end-to-end change lineage visible

interactions.effect: open the exact source binding and revision

availability.note: All represented lifecycle stages have exact repository revisions; Gate A remains pending rather than being inferred from deployment.

rationale: Traceability is the primary question, so the lifecycle relationships remain semantic-view data rather than SurfaceSpec metadata.
successCriteria: A reviewer can follow one change from current planning authority to the deployed UI and identify which review decision still remains human-owned.

viewSpecs.concern: What semantic path must architecture facts follow before they reach the product UI?

interactions.effect: show owning source and exact implementation seam
interactions.purpose: prevent representation or renderer code from masquerading as semantic authority

availability.note: The DoDAF repository owns the meaning and eligibility of each stage.

rationale: A directed architecture view makes the single-path invariant and forbidden shadow path perceptually cheap to inspect.
successCriteria: A reviewer can point to the single canonical semantic path and explain why representation grammar is downstream of semantic projection.

viewSpecs.concern: Which implementation seams realize the semantic-path change?

interactions.purpose: review implementation without reconstructing it from repository search

rationale: A source-seam ledger is lower notation cost than another architecture graph for exact file/revision review.
successCriteria: An implementer can identify the code and generated-artifact seams that carry semantics into the UI.

viewSpecs.concern: What evidence shows the semantic-path change works, and what does that evidence not prove?

interactions.effect: open exact test or release receipt
interactions.purpose: separate technical proof from owner UI approval

availability.note: Deployment and tests establish implementation/evidence claims but do not establish owner approval.

rationale: An assurance matrix keeps exact claims and their evidence/nonclaims adjacent instead of flattening them into one green status.
successCriteria: A reviewer can distinguish semantic-path convergence evidence from the still-pending human UI approval.

viewSpecs.concern: What exact product UI was deployed for review, and what decision remains?

interactions.effect: preserve governed semantic focus or report not represented
interactions.purpose: review the same subject across useful product lenses

availability.note: The product candidate is deployed and verified, but approval remains a separate owner decision.

rationale: The actual application UI is itself the working representation under review; the review surface must not replace it with a proxy.
successCriteria: The owner can inspect the deployed candidate and make the Gate A decision without tests or deployment status being presented as approval.

viewSpecs.concern: What lifecycle gate is currently open or blocked after this change?

interactions.effect: show authoritative status source and unmet preconditions
interactions.purpose: prevent completed technical work from silently advancing product authority

rationale: A state/gate representation is the cheapest way to show why completed semantic convergence does not authorize backend work.
successCriteria: A maintainer can identify the next human-owned gate and the downstream work that remains unauthorized.

surfaceOptions.job: Review one real software change across planning, architecture, implementation, evidence, deployed product UI, and current lifecycle authority.
surfaceOptions.audience: mixed technical and non-technical software product reviewers

sourceBindings.note: Current durable-solo plan; S0-S6 complete, Gate A pending.
Decision provenance for one canonical semantic path.
Canonical DoDAF projection selection/grouping/readiness authority consumed by the reviewed product revision.
Generates canonical projection results and the browser/static semantic payload.
Protects generated semantic payload, supported/unsupported views, focus, evidence, and product invariants.
Records dodaf-mock-e01742e, 45/45 public-byte audit, local CI evidence, browser acceptance, and semantic custody.
UI approval pending; backend start remains ineligible.

successCriteria: A mixed-technical reviewer can trace the change from plan to deployed product behavior without opening raw code first.
The reviewer can distinguish semantic authority, implementation, evidence, deployment, and owner approval as separate states.
The surface never implies that deployment or passing tests approved Gate A or authorized Backend/M2.
notes: Gate A approval remains external to this SurfaceSpec because no authoritative write-back contract was supplied.
DoDAF-specific lifecycle relations live in the lifecycle-trace ViewSpec projection, not in the generic SurfaceSpec contract.
